newsitem.title: USA: Police detain Fla. man in drowning deaths of two sons.
newsitem.headline: Police detain Fla. man in drowning deaths of two sons.

text.p: Police on Friday detained a Florida man in connection with the drowning of his two sons, saying he put the boys in his girlfriend's car after the couple had a fight and then drove the car into a canal.

"The vehicle was occupied by the girlfriend's two boys, both under the age of five years," the Metro-Dade police department said. "The boyfriend drove the vehicle into a canal ... Both young boys drowned as a result."
The man, identified as Kirk Billie Sr., a member of the Miccosukee Indian tribe, then went home, but he was later taken into custody by police.
Charges were pending as homicide investigators interviewed the man about the deaths of 3-year-old Keith and 5-year-old Kirk Billie.
Relatives of the man told television reporters that the couple had a relationship marked by fights and domestic violence.
Police said the couple had a third son, a 1-year-old, but he was not in the car.
